description.en: Open the Explorer at Crocodylomorpha to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开鳄形类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Carnufex time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Archaeopteryx and Neornithes through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较始祖鸟与今鸟类；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the 168.3–163.5 Ma lower Shishugou Formation window for IVPP V14010, a nearly complete skull, mandible and articulated anterior postcranium used to discuss reduced cranial kinesis. The 165.9 Ma focus is a rounded midpoint for map navigation, not a direct specimen date or an ancestry claim.
description.zh: 在地图中打开下石树沟组 168.3–163.5 Ma 的 IVPP V14010 窗口；该标本保存近完整头骨、下颌及关节相连的前部躯干，研究据此讨论头骨运动性降低。165.9 Ma 仅为地图导航使用的区间中点，不是标本直接测年或祖先关系声明。

limitations: This study-level lower Shishugou occurrence and rounded midpoint do not establish the genus-wide first or last appearance, direct ancestry, or a uniquely resolved crocodylian skull transition.

description.en: Open the 150–148 Ma Bavarian lithographic-limestone window anchored by referred Archaeopteryx specimens, including the Painten specimen. The 149 Ma focus summarizes correlated Kimmeridgian–Tithonian horizons and is not a direct date for avialan origins or a claim that one specimen is ancestral to living birds.
description.zh: 在地图中打开由巴伐利亚石印石灰岩始祖鸟归入标本（包括派恩滕标本）限定的 150–148 Ma 窗口。149 Ma 是对相关启莫里期—提通期层位的概括，不是鸟翼类起源的直接测年，也不表示某件标本是现生鸟类的祖先。

limitations: The interval is a source-bounded Bavarian specimen envelope; it is not a global Avialae first appearance, a crown-bird origin date, or a complete distribution.

description.en: Open the 3.6–2.6 Ma Playa Los Lobos window anchored by the Llallawavis scagliai sample used for anatomical, phylogenetic and sensory analyses. The 3.1 Ma focus is a rounded stage midpoint and represents this specimen context only, not the family-wide duration or ecology of every terror bird.
description.zh: 在地图中打开由拉氏拉劳鸟（Llallawavis scagliai）样本限定的 Playa Los Lobos 3.6–2.6 Ma 窗口；该样本用于形态、系统发育与感觉能力分析。3.1 Ma 是地层区间的近似中点，只代表这件标本的背景，不是整个恐鹤科的生存时限或所有成员的生态。

limitations: This map card exposes the sampled Llallawavis interval only; it does not assert a global phorusrhacid first or last appearance, complete distribution, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the 66.8–66.7 Ma Maastricht Formation window for NHMM 2013 008, whose three-dimensionally preserved CT-imaged skull and associated postcrania test a near-K–Pg crown-bird placement. The 66.75 Ma focus is a rounded interval midpoint; alternative phylogenetic analyses remain part of the evidence boundary.
description.zh: 在地图中打开马斯特里赫特组 66.8–66.7 Ma 的 NHMM 2013 008 窗口；其三维保存、经 CT 成像的头骨和伴生肢后骨骼用于检验接近 K–Pg 界线的冠群鸟类位置。66.75 Ma 是区间中点，替代系统发育分析仍属于证据边界。

limitations: This tightly constrained holotype horizon is not a direct crown-bird divergence date, a global first appearance, or a uniquely resolved phylogenetic placement.

description.en: Open the 69.2–68.4 Ma Sandwich Bluff Member window on Vega Island for the nearly complete skull AMNH FARB 30899. The 68.8 Ma focus is a rounded midpoint of the reported unit age; crown-waterfowl affinity is an analysis-dependent hypothesis rather than a direct age or ancestry observation.
description.zh: 在地图中打开维加岛桑德维奇崖段 69.2–68.4 Ma 的 AMNH FARB 30899 窗口；该标本保存近完整头骨。68.8 Ma 是研究所报岩层年龄的近似中点；冠群水禽亲缘位置依赖分析结果，不是直接年代或祖先观察。

limitations: The map window follows the fossil-bearing unit and one combined placement test; it is not a direct specimen date, crown-Neornithes divergence time, global first appearance, or complete distribution.
